name: Super Dangan Ronpa 2x2
original_name: スーパーダンガンロンパ２×２
source:
Jabberwock Island – once a popular tourist destination, this now uninhabited island remains oddly pristine. You and your classmates at the elite Hope's Peak Academy have been brought to this island by your super-cute teacher for a “lovey-dovey, heart-throbbing school trip.” Everyone seems to be having fun in the sun...until Monokuma returns to restart his murderous game! Trapped on this island of mutual killing, your only hope of escape rests in solving the island’s mysteries. But be warned—sometimes the truth can be its own despair...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751230/Danganronpa_2x2/]Steam[/url]]

Danganronpa 2x2 features the same cast, setting, and premise as [url=https://vndb.org/v7679]Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair[/url], but with a brand new full-length scenario that deviates from its predecessor very early on, resulting in a killing game with a fresh chain of victims, culprits, and tricks.
translation:
贾伯沃克岛——曾经是一个受欢迎的旅游目的地，这座现在无人居住的岛屿仍然保持着奇怪的原始状态。你和你在精英希望之峰学院的同学们被你的超级可爱的老师带到了这个岛上，进行了一次“恩爱、心动的修学旅行”。每个人似乎都在阳光下玩得很开心……直到Monokuma回来重新开始他的杀人游戏！被困在这个互相残杀的岛屿上，你唯一的逃脱希望就是解开岛上的谜团。但请注意——有时真相本身可能就是绝望……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751230/Danganronpa_2x2/]蒸汽[/url]]

《弹丸论破2x2》的演员阵容、场景和前提与《弹丸论破2x2》相同[url=https://vndb.org/v7679]《弹丸论破2：再见绝望》[/url]，但有着一个全新的全长场景，与前作很早就有所不同，导致了一场充满受害者、罪犯和诡计的新链条的杀戮游戏。
